PulseShader {{VERSION}}
Custom PBR and NPR model shaders for Left 4 Dead 2.

============================================================
HOW TO INSTALL
============================================================

1. Download the .zip file from this release.

2. Right-click the .zip and choose "Extract All".
   Inside you will find a folder named "left4dead2".

3. Open your Left 4 Dead 2 game folder. It is usually here:
   C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Left 4 Dead 2

4. Copy the "left4dead2" folder from step 2 into the game
   folder from step 3. The files just get added in.

5. If Windows asks to replace or overwrite a file, only say
   yes if you are updating an older PulseShader. Otherwise
   stop, because it means another mod uses that file.

That's it. Start the game and use a Pulse shader in your
model's material to see it.

============================================================
HOW TO UNINSTALL
============================================================

Delete these files from your game folder:

   left4dead2\bin\game_shader_generic_pulse.dll
   left4dead2\bin\game_shader_generic_pulse
   left4dead2\shaders\fxc\pulse_*.vcs
